facts.business: Tahmar Enterprises Limited operates a distillery at Beradwadi, Maharashtra, producing distilled spirits and denatured spirit, and is pursuing a potable liquor licence.

capacity_or_capex.item: Effluent, zero liquid discharge and air pollution control systems upgrade

guidance_or_targets.statement: Tahmar enters FY 2026-27 with the fullest licence position it has held since acquiring the unit, a bottling line ready to commission, and a plant that has been rebuilt to run.
guidance_or_targets.value: Full licence position, bottling line ready, plant rebuilt

auditor.name: Not explicitly named in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material uncertainty related to going concern due to cash credit facility classified as NPA and liquidity constraints

key_risks: Suspension of manufacturing operations throughout FY 2025-26 due to regulatory restrictions
Cash credit facility classified as non-performing asset (NPA) by bank as of 31 March 2026
Liquidity constraints with cash and cash equivalents of only ₹13.37 Lakhs
Dependence on monetisation of assets for debt repayment
Regulatory and environmental compliance risks for distillery operations
